queue.title: Spec R1 -- explore and propose the F274 change
queue.detail: DONE, iteration 3. Proposed as openspec/changes/2026-09-05-the-conversation-carries-its-own-run-facts -- proposal.md, design.md, tasks.md and the specs/agent-stream-events/spec.md delta (two ADDED requirements, one MODIFIED). openspec validate --strict passes. The fix: both chat-history responses carry runs: Dict[str, RunFacts] built by primary-key lookup over the run ids their OWN returned entries name, and AgentTimeline takes its runs prop from the chat response instead of the timeline query. R1 overturned F274's own requirement position -- the route is not in breach, but 'A run's terminal outcome is visible' (agent-stream-events:299) IS, and its cross-reference points at a sibling that cannot forbid the case; FINDINGS.md's F274 entry now carries that correction. R1 also found that get_chat_history applies no limit at all, which kills 'widen the event window' as an alternative, and that the chat hooks do not invalidate on run lifecycle events, which the move requires. F274 stays open until implemented.

(a) D5 stands, with a new scenario making its guard durable; (b) and (c) confirmed exactly as R1 argued them. One citation wrong: models.py:1180 -> :1179. validate --strict passes.
